archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Modified for 'Industrial Executive' Command Center)

headings.instruction: Use for all module titles, metric hero numbers, and primary card headings. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight). Represents structural authority.

body.instruction: Use for readable lists, descriptions, and CRM data. Prioritize legibility in dense interfaces.

monospace.instruction: MANDATORY for all Growth Score numbers, metric data points, and tabular data (CRM/Invoices) to ensure perfect vertical column alignment.

colors.instructions: Strict Dark Mode implementation. DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe blue. Use pure #09090B (Tailwind zinc-950) for the app shell and #18181B for widget cards. The primary accent (Signal Orange #F97316) is reserved exclusively for AI 'Fix this for me' actions and primary growth drivers.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical Look). 1px solid borders (border-white/10). No soft shadows on cards. The UI must feel like a tactical, objective dashboard.
visual_enhancers.ai_highlights: Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect (a glowing gradient border mask) on the 'Next Best Action' and Growth Opportunities cards to signal AI intelligence.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky headers, floating command palettes, or dialog overlays. Must use high blur (backdrop-blur-xl) and a crisp 1px inner border (border-white/10). Do NOT use transparent backgrounds without blur.

layouts.app_shell: Modern SaaS layout: Fixed left sidebar (w-64). Main content area takes the remaining width. Sidebar must visually differentiate active V1 modules from 'locked/coming soon' V2 modules (use opacity-50 and a small lock icon).
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Bento style) for the Command Center. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Ensure all metric cards stretch vertically to fill rows (h-full).
layouts.pipeline_board: Kanban board style with a horizontal scrolling container. Columns must have distinct, subtle background tints (e.g., bg-zinc-900/50) and clear drop zones.
layouts.ai_review_ui: Use a split-pane or bottom-drawer layout for the AI generation review/approve flow, keeping context visible.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary 'Fix this for me' buttons must have maximum contrast (Black text on Signal Orange bg). Include a subtle pulse animation for high-priority AI actions.
components.cards: Customize Shadcn Card component: Remove default shadows, set background to zinc-900, border to border-white/10. Internal padding should be dense (p-4 to p-6).
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs with zinc-900 background, focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-orange-500. No heavy outlines.
components.tables: Use tabular-nums class for all numerical data. Subtle hover effect on rows (hover:bg-zinc-800/50).
components.tabs: Override default Shadcn tabs height (h-auto) and use a technical indicator (e.g., a sharp orange underline for the active tab).

motion.micro_interactions: All interactive elements must change state on hover (e.g., text color brightens, subtle border change). Click/press states should use active:scale-95.
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in (framer-motion) for dashboard widgets. Content should appear systematically, not all at once.
motion.ai_generation: Use shimmering skeleton loaders while AI is processing. Output text in the review UI MUST use a typewriter/streaming reveal animation.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Use pure white for primary text against dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-orange-500 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all streaming and pulse animations.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-grow', data-testid='fix-this-button', data-testid='pipeline-stage').

onboarding_hero.description: Smiling man in modern office setting - use for auth page split-screen or onboarding welcome wizard.

auth_background.description: Abstract gray geometric building - use as full-bleed background alternative for the login/register screen with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/80).

community_avatar.description: Professional man on phone - use as dummy data for CRM leads or review customers to add realism.

media.instructions: Never use placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). If rendering avatars for the CRM or Reviews, use the provided community_avatar or generic Lucide user icons. Avoid generic stock photography inside the dashboard itself; reserve it for Auth and Onboarding.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (already installed). DO NOT use AI assistant emoji characters.
libraries.charts: recharts (wrapped in Shadcn Chart components) for the Growth Score gauge, metric cards, and SEO health trackers.
libraries.motion: framer-motion for the dashboard staggered entrance, pipeline drag-and-drop (or standard react-beautiful-dnd/dnd-kit), and AI streaming reveals.
libraries.notifications: sonner for all success/error toasts. Located at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Venturelyx' - a Business Command Center for business owners. Use owner-friendly, empowering language; avoid dense developer jargon.
Implement the UI exclusively in React .jsx and .js files (no TypeScript / .tsx files as per existing structure).
Maintain high density and strict optical alignment for the dashboard.
DO NOT apply 'transition: all' globally in CSS. Target specific properties to prevent breaking layout transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Ensure standard left alignment for reading flow.
Use Generous Spacing for the main dashboard shell padding (p-8 or p-12), but keep widget internal padding tight (p-4 or p-6).
Explicitly render the left sidebar with all 6 modules, applying visual locks (opacity-50 + icon) to GROW, SOURCE, and AI TEAM if they are strictly V2.
Highlight the 'Fix this for me' buttons prominently using the primary Signal Orange color.
Mock AI generation logic using setTimeout/Promises to demonstrate the review/approve flow with the streaming text effect.
Ensure all Shadcn components are fully customized via Tailwind to match the dark 'Grid Borders' technical theme.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all major interactive components (buttons, inputs, navigation links) to support E2E testing.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic Vercel-like gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, even in flat/technical designs (e.g., Command Palettes casting deep shadows).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where necessary, such as sticky headers or modal backdrops.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded corners) with clear interaction animations (hover/active states).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭). Use clean Lucide icons (e.g., Sparkles, Zap, Activity).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui before creating custom HTML elements for standard interactions.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
